name: Shop Manager for WooCommerce – AI-Powered Frontend Dashboard & Smart Order, Product & Employee Management
author: Oxilab

sections.description:
Shop Manager for WooCommerce gives store owners and managers a clean, fast frontend dashboard to run their entire WooCommerce store, without needing access to the WordPress admin.

Whether you’re handling 10 orders a day or 500, the goal was simple: make WooCommerce management feel less like work. Every screen is built around what you actually need to do, create orders, update statuses, manage products, track customers, not what the database looks like on the inside.

✨ All Features | 💰 Upgrade to Pro | 📖 Documentation | 🆘 Support

All in one WooCommerce Frontend Dashboard

Most WooCommerce store managers spend half their day inside the WordPress backend, an interface that was never really designed for high-volume order management. Shop Manager replaces that with a purpose-built frontend dashboard that’s fast, intuitive, and actually pleasant to use.

You get full order management, product management, a real-time analytics dashboard, a customer CRM and store notifications, all in one place. The Pro version adds abandoned cart recovery, PDF invoices and AI tools that write your product content and answer questions about your store.

🚀 Key Features

  • Frontend WooCommerce dashboard: manage your entire store without logging into the WordPress admin
  • Full order management: create, edit, delete, bulk-update, and export orders as CSV, with each refund shown clearly on the order
  • Complete product management: add/edit products with variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
  • Product import: Bulk Upload brings in a WooCommerce product CSV whole, every product type, variations, attributes, pictures and custom fields
  • Coupons: every WooCommerce coupon by active, expired and used up; create, edit, duplicate and turn coupons on or off, and see each coupon’s uses, sales and discount given
  • Advanced coupon rules (Pro): Buy X Get Y, coupons that apply by themselves, coupon links, start dates, days and hours, roles and customers, one use per person, and hundreds of single-use codes at once
  • Gift cards (Pro): issue gift cards or sell them as products, each with its balance and history
  • Store credit and points (Pro): give store credit or refund an order to it, and let customers earn points they exchange for store credit
  • Real-time analytics: revenue, average order value, top products, and order trends, live, no 12-hour cache delay
  • Customer list & profiles: full purchase history, billing & shipping addresses, notes and communication log, order stats, and tags
  • Print orders & packing slips: print a single order or a whole batch straight from the browser, one order per page, no PDF plugin and no Pro licence needed
  • Shipping labels & shipment tracking: record the carrier and tracking number for 151 couriers in 55 countries, and print labels with scannable Code 128 barcodes straight from the browser
  • Notifications: a bell in the dashboard for new orders, failed payments, cancellations, refunds, customer notes, low stock and new reviews, with desktop notices and a sound for new orders
  • Abandoned cart recovery (Pro): save the carts customers leave at checkout after giving their email or phone, send up to five reminder emails with a coupon, and win them back from the Abandoned Carts page
  • Invoice PDF generation (Pro): generate, download, and email professional invoices
  • Employee management & role-based access: add staff, assign roles, and control exactly who can see and do what
  • Custom order statuses (Pro): create unlimited custom statuses with color presets that fit your exact workflow
  • AI chat assistant (Pro): ask questions about your store in plain language and get answers from live data, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employees
  • AI product content generator (Pro): write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
  • Customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive, with no AI key needed
  • Dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store right now, with no AI key needed
  • Your own AI keys (Pro): works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Google Gemini; keys are AES-256 encrypted
  • CSV export: export product lists and order data for reporting, accounting, or migration
  • Built for WooCommerce HPOS: fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage

✅ Free Version Features

The free version covers the essentials, enough to manage a real store day to day:

✅ Frontend dashboard: view and run your store without touching the WP admin
✅ Order management: create, view, edit, and delete orders, with search and bulk actions, and what was refunded of each item on the order page
✅ Advanced order filters: stack filters by status, date range, customer and order total to find exactly the orders you need
✅ Print orders and packing slips: one order or a whole batch, printed from your browser, no PDF plugin needed
✅ Print designer with live preview: document title, paper size, logo, colours, and every section on or off; turn prices off to get a packing slip
✅ Shipment tracking for 151 couriers in 55 countries: record the carrier and tracking number on any order, or a whole batch at once, with the tracking link already built in, plus a custom carrier option for anyone not on the list. No API keys, no account, works offline
✅ Shipping labels with scannable Code 128 barcodes: A4, A5, 4×6 inch, or 80/58 mm thermal roll, printed from your browser, with the delivery address, parcel contents, and the cash-on-delivery amount to collect
✅ Customer tracking notifications: the tracking number and a Track your parcel link in WooCommerce order emails and on My Account, and it steps aside automatically if you already run Advanced Shipment Tracking
✅ Barcode scanning: scan a shipping label with any USB scanner to find an order or move it to another status, and find any order by its tracking number from the search box
✅ Product management: create, edit, and delete products, with variations, categories, brands, tags, attributes, and reviews
✅ Product import (Bulk Upload): import a WooCommerce product export whole, with pictures, in parts with a progress bar, and choose to update or skip products you already have
✅ Coupons: every WooCommerce coupon by active, expired and used up; create and edit them with every WooCommerce coupon setting, bulk actions, and a page per coupon with its uses, sales and discount given
✅ Real-time analytics: revenue, average order value, and top products
✅ Customer list: full purchase history on every profile
✅ Customer notes & communication log: keep a record of every interaction on the customer profile
✅ Customer segmentation: filter customers by tag, spend, or behaviour
✅ Customer auto-tagging: automatically segments customers as VIP, Loyal, At Risk, Big Spender, Frequent, New, or Inactive, using thresholds you set. Rule-based, so no AI key is needed
✅ Dashboard insight cards: plain-English summaries of what’s happening in your store right now, with no AI key needed
✅ Notifications: a bell in the dashboard for new orders, failed payments, refunds, low stock and reviews, with desktop notices and a sound for new orders. Each staff member sees only what their role allows
✅ Employee management and role-based access: control who can see and do what
✅ CSV export: export your orders and products for reporting or accounting
✅ Fully responsive: works on desktop, tablet, and mobile

🔥 Pro Version Features

Pro unlocks the full toolkit for growing stores:

✅ AI chat assistant: ask about your store in plain language, orders, revenue, products, customers, and employee activity, answered from live data
✅ AI product content generator: write product titles, short descriptions, and full descriptions with one click
✅ Multi-provider AI support: works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and Google Gemini; bring your own API key
✅ Invoice PDF generation: generate and download professional invoices. Also send to customer with email
✅ Custom order statuses (unlimited): with color presets and visual workflow control
✅ Abandoned cart recovery: carts customers leave at checkout after giving their email or phone, up to five reminder emails with a coupon, WhatsApp and text message buttons, a weekly recovery report, a webhook, and an Abandoned Carts page to win them back
✅ Advanced coupon rules: Buy X Get Y with the free item added by itself, coupons that apply by themselves, coupon links, start dates, weekdays and hours, roles and customers, first order only, one use per person, and bulk single-use codes as CSV
✅ Gift cards: issue gift cards by email or sell them as products, with each card’s balance and history in one place
✅ Store credit: give credit to any customer or refund an order to it; customers see it in My Account and choose how much to use at checkout
✅ Points: customers earn points on what they buy, plus welcome, review and birthday bonuses, and exchange them for store credit
✅ Custom employee roles: build your own roles with a full capability matrix, deciding permission by permission what each one can view, add, change and delete
✅ Priority email support: 12h response

👉 See full Free vs Pro comparison

🎯 Perfect For

  • 🏪 Store owners who don’t want to spend time in the WordPress admin every morning
  • 👩‍💼 Shop managers and employees who need to handle orders without full admin access
  • 👨‍💻 WooCommerce developers and agencies building client dashboards that clients can actually use
  • 📦 High-volume stores that need fast bulk actions and reliable status workflows
  • 🌍 Multi-language stores: built with WordPress i18n and translation-ready throughout

📈 Why Shop Manager

There are a handful of WooCommerce frontend manager plugins out there, but most of them were built years ago and show it. Shop Manager was designed from scratch, built with React, tested against real store workflows, and updated regularly.

Here is what actually sets it apart:

  • 🤖 AI tools built in (Pro): not a third-party integration; the AI chat assistant and the product content generator are part of Shop Manager Pro. Bring your own API key for Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini and it just works. Customer tagging is rule-based and free, with no key needed.
  • ⚡ Real-time data: the dashboard pulls live data, not cached summaries from 12 hours ago
  • 🏷️ Smart customer tagging: customers are automatically segmented based on actual order behavior, not manual effort. Tags update when orders change.
  • 📋 Workflow-first order management: custom statuses, bulk actions, and CSV export are all designed around how fulfillment workflows actually work
  • 🔒 Secure by default: API keys are AES-256 encrypted, all REST endpoints are nonce-verified, and user access respects WooCommerce roles
  • 🔄 HPOS compatible: fully tested with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage, which is default in WooCommerce 8.0+
sections.installation:
⬇️ Option 1: Install from WordPress.org (Recommended)

  1. 🔑 Log into your WordPress admin
  2. 🔍 Go to Plugins > Add New and search for Shop Manager for WooCommerce
  3. 🖱️ Click Install Now, then Activate

📦 Option 2: Manual Upload

  1. ⬇️ Download the plugin zip from WordPress.org
  2. 📂 Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. 📤 Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. ✅ Click Activate Plugin

🚀 Getting Started

  1. 🧭 A short setup wizard opens after activation: watch a short video, then choose the dashboard page, rows per page, your logo, colours and modules. Skip any step to keep its defaults, or skip all and go straight to Getting Started
  2. 📄 Activating the plugin creates a page called SM Dashboard for you. That page is the frontend dashboard, at yoursite.com/sm-dashboard/. There is nothing to build and no shortcode to place.
  3. 🔗 Open it from the Frontend Dashboard button at the top of Shop Manager in your WordPress admin sidebar, or go straight to the URL
  4. 👥 Add your staff and choose what each of them can see and do, from Employees inside the dashboard
  5. 🤖 To use the Pro AI features, go to Shop Manager > AI Settings and enter your API key
  6. 🏷️ Visit Customer Settings to set the thresholds used for automatic customer tagging
sections.faq:
📄 Where is the dashboard after I activate the plugin?

Activating Shop Manager creates a page called SM Dashboard on your site, at yoursite.com/sm-dashboard/. That page is the dashboard. You do not create a page yourself and there is no shortcode to place. The quickest way in is the Frontend Dashboard button at the top of the Shop Manager screen in your WordPress admin. If you ever delete the page, deactivating and reactivating the plugin creates it again.

🔌 Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. Shop Manager is built entirely on top of WooCommerce and requires it to be installed and active. It is not compatible with other eCommerce plugins.

🤖 Do the AI features cost extra?

Shop Manager never charges extra for AI. The two AI features that generate content, the AI product content generator and the AI chat assistant, are Pro features, and you bring your own API key from Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), or Google (Gemini), so you only pay your provider for what you actually use, typically $1–5 per month for average stores. The rule-based smart features, customer auto-tagging and dashboard insight cards, work in every plan including free and don’t need an API key at all.

🔒 Is my API key stored securely?

Yes. API keys are encrypted with AES-256-CBC using your WordPress secret keys before being saved to the database. The raw key is never exposed in the browser, API responses, or log files.

⚡ Does it work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. Shop Manager is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS), which became the default in WooCommerce 8.0.

🏷️ How does customer auto-tagging work?

When an order is placed or its status changes, Shop Manager automatically recalculates tags for the customer based on their order history. Tags like VIP, Loyal, At Risk, and Big Spender are defined by thresholds you set in the admin settings, and you can adjust those thresholds at any time. Changing thresholds triggers a recalculation for all customers automatically.

🛒 Can I create and edit orders from the frontend?

Yes, in the free version. You can create an order, edit an existing one, delete it, filter the list however you like, run bulk actions and export to CSV, all without opening the WordPress admin. Pro adds unlimited custom order statuses on top.

👥 Can shop employees use this without admin access?

Yes. You can control who can access the frontend dashboard through WordPress role settings. The plugin respects the excluded roles configuration in the admin settings.

📱 Does it work on mobile?

The frontend dashboard is responsive and usable on mobile, though it is designed primarily for desktop use by store managers. All core workflows, order management, product editing, customer review, work on tablet and mobile.

🔄 What happens to existing data when I activate the plugin?

Your store data is untouched. Shop Manager reads your existing WooCommerce orders, products and customers, and never migrates or rewrites any of it. The only thing activation adds is the SM Dashboard page that holds the dashboard itself.

🆓 Is there really a free version?

Yes, and it is not a trial. The free version includes the frontend dashboard, full order management, printing and packing slips, shipping labels and tracking for 151 couriers, product management, the customer list with auto-tagging, real-time analytics with insight cards, employee management and CSV export. Pro adds the AI chat assistant, AI product content generation, PDF invoices, unlimited custom order statuses and custom employee roles.

🔑 Which AI providers are supported?

Shop Manager works with Anthropic Claude, OpenAI (GPT), and Google Gemini. You bring your own API key, so you only pay your provider for what you actually use, there’s no markup or subscription through Shop Manager.

🏷️ Can I create unlimited custom order statuses in the free version?

No. The free version lets you filter and manage your existing WooCommerce order statuses. Creating unlimited custom statuses, with color presets, is a Pro feature.

🧾 Does the invoice generator support multiple templates?

Yes. Invoice PDF generation is a Pro feature and includes four templates, Modern, Classic, Bold, and Minimal, so you can match your brand. Invoices can be downloaded individually or in bulk.

🖨️ Can I print orders and packing slips?

Yes, and it is free. Open any order and click Print, use the Print action in the orders list row menu, or select several orders and use Print Orders to get one document with a single order per page. The sheet opens in a new tab and goes straight to your browser’s print dialog, so no PDF plugin, no extra library and no Pro licence is involved.

Under Shop Manager → Print Order you get a designer with a live preview: set the document title (Order, Packing Slip, Delivery Note), paper size, logo, colours, and switch individual sections on or off, order status, payment and shipping method, billing and shipping addresses, product images, SKU, item options, prices, totals, notes and footer. Turning prices off produces a packing slip with quantities only. Company details left empty fall back to your WooCommerce store settings, so invoices and packing slips always name the same store.

💾 Will my customer notes and tags be lost if I switch from Pro back to free?

No. Your data stays in your WooCommerce database either way, and customer notes and tags are both free features, so they keep working after a downgrade. Pro-only features like unlimited custom order statuses become read-only until you reactivate Pro. Nothing is ever deleted.

🗑️ What happens to my orders and data if I deactivate or uninstall the plugin?

Deactivating keeps everything untouched, your orders, products, and customer data all live in WooCommerce’s own database, not in a separate table. Uninstalling removes only the plugin’s own settings and custom tags, your actual store data is never touched. The SM Dashboard page stays where it is, and simply shows nothing until the plugin is active again.

⚡ Does this plugin slow down my store?

No. Dashboard and analytics data is cached briefly to keep things fast, and AI features only run when you actively use them, they don’t run in the background or affect your storefront’s loading speed for customers.

🧩 Will this plugin conflict with other WooCommerce extensions like Subscriptions or Bookings?

Shop Manager works alongside standard WooCommerce order and product data, so it doesn’t override how other extensions handle their own custom order types. As with any plugin that touches order management, highly customized workflows are best tested on a staging site first.

🔌 What happens if I don’t add an AI API key?

Everything except the AI product content generator and the AI chat assistant works normally. Customer auto-tagging, insight cards, orders, products, customers, and employee management are all unaffected, since those don’t call any AI provider. You only need a key for the two features that generate or answer with AI.

👥 Can multiple employees see different parts of the dashboard at the same time?

Yes. Role-based access is per-user, so two employees logged in at the same time each see only what their role allows, one might manage orders while another only views products, based on the permissions you set.

📈 Why Shop Manager

There are a handful of WooCommerce frontend manager plugins out there, but most of them were built years ago and show it. Shop Manager was designed from scratch, built with React, tested against real store workflows, and updated regularly.

Here is what actually sets it apart:

  • 🤖 AI tools built in (Pro): not a third-party integration; the AI chat assistant and the product content generator are part of Shop Manager Pro. Bring your own API key for Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini and it just works. Customer tagging is rule-based and free, with no key needed.
  • ⚡ Real-time data: the dashboard pulls live data, not cached summaries from 12 hours ago
  • 🏷️ Smart customer tagging: customers are automatically segmented based on actual order behavior, not manual effort. Tags update when orders change.
  • 📋 Workflow-first order management: custom statuses, bulk actions, and CSV export are all designed around how fulfillment workflows actually work
  • 🔒 Secure by default: API keys are AES-256 encrypted, all REST endpoints are nonce-verified, and user access respects WooCommerce roles
  • 🔄 HPOS compatible: fully tested with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage, which is default in WooCommerce 8.0+
